About this collection

Lesson citations identify the work behind a construction, reproduced object, or research claim. Each links back to the lessons that use it.

Further reading opens related paths. Historical sources retain their period context; a surviving link does not make every statement current.

Historical sources and accessHow to read older records+

Original editions, translations, later reproductions, and archived web pages are different kinds of evidence. The records identify which one a lesson uses. Unavailable original sites remain labeled as historical references; access to a mirror does not establish completeness or update an old mathematical claim.
